title: Safety-Critical Formula Fixes — Taylor, Units, Chatter, Singularity
brief: Fix all 38 CRITICAL findings from 20-agent scrutiny. Tier 0: Taylor exponent bug (3 engines), unit errors 60x/1000x (3 engines), Ti kc1_1=1400→2800, chatter double directional factor + phase swap + 1000x unit error + ae/ap confusion. Tier 1: singularity inversion (3 engines), RTCP pivot composition (2 engines), J-C temperature K/C (2 engines), SurfaceFinish nose radius, ChipThickness discontinuity, Bootstrap Cpk, HSS deflection E.

engines: SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine.ts (2265: E_carbide hardcoded, ignores tool material)

phases.title: Tier 0 — Taylor Exponent + Unit Errors (IMMEDIATE)
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Manufacturing Physicist + Numerical Methods | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Every Taylor tool life prediction and power/MRR calculation produces correct results. No more orders-of-magnitude errors.

units.title: Fix Taylor exponent in MonteCarloEngine, AdaptiveCalibrationEngine, CryogenicCuttingEngine
units.description: Replace C/Math.pow(Vc,1/n) with Math.pow(C/Vc,1/n) in 3 engines (5 locations). Verify against canonical taylorLife() in constants.ts. Run existing tests to confirm no regression.

units.title: Fix unit errors: CuttingForceEngine MRR /60, SpecificCuttingEnergy power *1000 + ae vs D
units.description: CuttingForceEngine:157 remove spurious /60 from MRR. SpecificCuttingEnergyEngine:151 remove *1000 from power calc. SpecificCuttingEnergyEngine:176 change ae to tool diameter D for RPM calc.
exit_conditions: RPM uses tool diameter not ae

units.title: Fix Ti kc1_1=1400→2800 in UltimateSpeedFeedEngine + KienzleForceModel h_avg 2x error
units.description: UltimateSpeedFeedEngine:512 change titanium kc1_1 from 1400 to 2800 and mc from 0.22 to 0.28. KienzleForceModelEngine:500 fix milling h_avg formula for full slotting (ae/D→2*ae/(pi*D) or use Martellotti).

phases.title: Tier 0 — Chatter/Stability Formula Cascade
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Vibration Physicist + Controls Engineer | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Stability lobe diagrams produce correct critical depths, lobes at correct RPMs, and use the right DOC dimension. No more false chatter alarms or missed instability.

units.title: Fix ChatterSLD: remove Ks*0.5 (double directional), fix atan2 phase, import canonical KC11
units.description: Line 75: remove the *0.5 from Ks (alpha_xx already handles immersion). Line 141: fix atan2(imG,reG)→atan2(reG,imG) per Altintas. Line 69: import CANONICAL_KIENZLE from constants.ts instead of hardcoded inflated values.
exit_conditions: a_lim matches Altintas analytical for SDOF test case

units.title: Fix RegenerativeChatter 1000x unit error + MachineVibration ae→ap
units.description: RegenerativeChatterPredictor:110 add *1000 for m→mm conversion. MachineVibrationEngine:155 change stabilityRatio=ae/blim to ap/blim.

units.title: Write chatter physics regression tests with known analytical solutions
units.description: Add tests for: SDOF a_lim at lobe peak vs analytical, lobe RPM positions for 3-flute at fn=1000Hz, multi-mode FRF with 2 modes. Pin against Altintas Table 3.1.
exit_conditions: 5+ regression tests with analytical reference values

phases.title: Tier 0+1 — Multi-Axis Singularity + RTCP + J-C Temperature
phases.smart_config: ROLE=5-Axis Kinematics + Controls Engineer | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: 5-axis singularity warnings fire at the correct angle (A≈0 not A≈90). RTCP pivot uses composed rotation matrix. Johnson-Cook uses consistent temperature units across all engines.

units.title: Invert singularity detection in MultiAxisPrintToProgram, FiveAxisPost, MultiAxisKinematic
units.description: Change thresholds to flag A near 0 (gimbal lock) instead of A near 90 (workspace boundary). MultiAxisPrintToProgram:228 swap high/medium/low thresholds. FiveAxisPostEngine:160 change abs(a-90)→abs(a) check. MultiAxisKinematicEngine:579 fix singularityProximity.
exit_conditions: Singularity warning at A<5 deg (high), A<15 (med)

units.title: Fix RTCP pivot compensation: composed rotation matrix instead of per-axis decomposition
units.description: MultiAxisKinematicEngine:665,742 replace per-axis cos(pRad)/cos(sRad) with full R(primary,secondary)*pivot_vector. RTCP_CompensationEngine:137 remove cosC from Z-compensation for head_table BC config.
exit_conditions: Z-comp independent of C for BC head_table

units.title: Standardize J-C temperature to Kelvin across JohnsonCookEngine + AdvancedCuttingPhysics
units.description: JohnsonCookEngine:135 add @param JSDoc documenting Kelvin. AdvancedCuttingPhysicsEngine:28 convert JohnsonCookMaterial interface Tm/Tr from C to K (add 273.15 at input boundary). Add conversion guard.
exit_conditions: Both engines produce identical flow stress for same inputs

phases.title: Tier 1 — Surface Finish, Chip Thickness, SPC, Deflection Fixes
phases.intent: Surface finish predictions use correct nose radius. Chip thinning has no discontinuities. SPC bootstrap Cpk is mathematically valid. HSS tool deflection uses correct E modulus.

units.title: Fix SurfaceFinishPredictor nose radius + SurfaceIntegrity Rz/Ra ratio
units.description: SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine:278 use corner_radius_mm (not D/2) for non-ball tools. SurfaceIntegrityEngine:110 change Rz=Ra*5 to Rz=Ra*4 (canonical kinematic ratio). Fix missing π in stiffness proxy (line 183).
exit_conditions: Ra uses corner_radius for flat endmills

units.title: Fix AdvancedChipThickness discontinuity + EngagementAdaptiveFeed sin(θ/2)
units.description: AdvancedChipThicknessEngine:136 remove hard cutoff at ae/D=0.5 — let 1/sqrt(ae/D) apply smoothly up to ae/D=1.0 where it naturally equals 1.0. EngagementAdaptiveFeedEngine:182,421 replace sin(θ/2) with Martellotti (1-cos(θ))/θ. Fix 'exact' model at line 443.

units.title: Fix Bootstrap Cpk + SpeedFeedOrchestrator HSS deflection + Hessian diagonal
units.description: StatisticalProcessMonitoringEngine:348 add USL/LSL to BootstrapCIInput, compute real Cpk. SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine:2265 import CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS and use resolved tool material (not always carbide). GradientOptimizationEngine:328 special-case i===j for standard 3-point stencil.

phases.title: Canonical Constants Migration — Force/Chatter/Deflection Engines
phases.smart_config: ROLE=TypeScript Architect + Manufacturing Physicist | OPUS | HIGH
phases.intent: All force, chatter, and deflection engines import kc1_1/mc from constants.ts. No more inline material databases in these critical engines.

units.title: Migrate force engines to canonical imports (CuttingForce, KienzleForce, UltimateSpeedFeed, SpeedFeedOrchestrator)
units.description: Replace inline KIENZLE/MATERIAL_DB tables with imports from CANONICAL_KIENZLE and CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB. Keep per-alloy overrides in KienzleForceModel as documented extensions of canonical group values. Add fallback chain: per-alloy → ISO group → canonical default.

units.title: Migrate chatter/vibration engines to canonical imports (ChatterSLD, StochasticChatter, MachineVibration, ConstraintSatisfaction)
units.description: Replace inline KC11/material tables with CANONICAL_KIENZLE imports. Replace inline E_MOD with CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS import.

units.title: Migrate thermal/surface/chip/drilling engines to canonical imports (8+ engines)
units.description: CuttingTemperatureEngine: import thermal conductivity from CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB. SurfaceFinishPredictor/SurfaceIntegrity/StochasticSurfaceFinish: import from constants.ts predictedRa(). ChipLoadEngine/EngagementAdaptiveFeed: import CANONICAL_KIENZLE. DrillBreakthrough/TappingTorque: import CANONICAL_KIENZLE.

phases.title: Enforcement Hook + Regression Prevention + Final Validation
phases.intent: No new engine can ever introduce inline physics constants again. A 20-agent re-scrutiny confirms zero CRITICAL findings remaining.

units.title: Create canonical-constants-enforcer hook blocking inline kc1_1/mc/Taylor values
units.description: PreToolUse hook that greps new engine code for patterns like 'kc1_1:', 'kc11:', 'mc:', 'taylor_C' without an import from constants.ts. Mode: warn (not block) for existing files, block for new files.
exit_conditions: Hook fires on test inline constant

units.title: Create cross-engine physics invariant test suite (30+ tests)
units.description: Test that Force→Power chain is consistent: Fc from KienzleForce × Vc / 60000 = Power from CuttingPowerBudget. Test Taylor life across all engines that compute it. Test Rz/Ra=4 across surface engines. Test singularity warnings at A=0. Test RTCP round-trip.
exit_conditions: Covers force→power, Taylor, Rz/Ra, singularity, RTCP

units.title: Re-run 20-agent scrutiny — confirm 0 CRITICAL, ≤10 HIGH remaining
units.description: Launch the same 20-agent scrutiny pass used to discover the original 250 findings. Verify all 38 CRITICALs resolved. Verify HIGH count dropped from 74 to ≤10. Document any remaining as accepted technical debt with justification.

forge_triple.hook: canonical-constants-enforcer — blocks new inline kc1_1/mc/Taylor in engine files
forge_triple.action: calc:physics_accuracy_audit — runs cross-engine invariant checks on demand
